conflicted_dates.status: unresolved; not used as award clock

quarter_convention: Q1 contains the verified initial execution date; it may be partial. Horizons end at the end of Q4, Q12 or Q20. Current or later amended allocations are never applied retrospectively.
snapshot_policy: Choose national OR Texas. Overlapping keys and revised amounts stay separate; neither concatenation nor silent replacement.
city_panel_grain: Snapshot × government relationship × verified Census place identity × original grant × requested activity category × calendar quarter. Original activity detail remains in the financial table. Relationship views overlap and must never be added.
cumulative_policy: Observed sums retain signed changes. Missing quarters, unknown opening balance and censored periods prevent certified cumulative ratios; absent source records are not zeros.
allocation_policy: Whole-grant award amounts, action-plan budgets and city/activity allocations are separate concepts. Later award snapshots are evidence, not historical local denominators.
